rationale.agent-scope-drift: Step-linked rules and hard stops bound departures from developer intent.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Users set enforcement checkpoints, pause execution, redirect agents, and approve rule changes.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Code evidence, test results, and progress views support human auditing.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Testable rules require executable unit-test evidence before step completion.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Persistent plans, evidence, notes, and histories create a human-reviewable audit trail.
rationale.survey-input: Practitioner study reports enforcement preferences, trust shifts, and intended adoption.
rationale.framework: Enrich-Enforce-Evolve is a reusable architecture integrated across coding-agent workflows.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented Zoro as a working CLI and interactive interface.
rationale.agentic: The system governs multi-step agent plans delivering repository-scale code changes.
rationale.steering: Plan enrichment and evolving rules substantively shape the agent's generation context.
rationale.risk-security: Participants applied enforced rules to PII, API-boundary, and dependency risks.
rationale.risk-quality: System enforces type safety, tests, conventions, and migration quality.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Study reports trust shifts and reduced manual supervision after visible proof.
rationale.method-self-report: Interviews and think-aloud accounts supplied participants' reported experiences.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled conditions and structured user tasks produced comparative evidence.
